data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"Both properties are required, but at different architectural layers. The writer must be safe (retry attempts are harmless or detectably redundant), and the replay/deduplication layer must be idempotent in its effect on derived state. The distinction between idempotent and safe is thus a layer-boundary distinction: safety is the property demanded of the producer (it may append duplicates, but they must be identifiable), while idempotency is the property demanded of the consumer/replay engine (processing a duplicate must not change derived state beyond the first processing). The append-only log requires safety of its writers and idempotency of its readers, not idempotency of its writers.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the replay engine is not idempotent in its deduplication (e.g., it uses a Bloom filter that can produce false negatives), then duplicate events may slip through and corrupt derived state","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the writer's identity scheme is insufficient (e.g., keys are unique per process restart rather than per logical operation), safety is violated","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If there is no clear boundary between writer and replay engine (e.g., in a single-process system), the layer distinction becomes ambiguous and the argument may not hold","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The system decomposes into a write path and a read/replay path. On the write path, at-least-once delivery means the writer may submit the same event multiple times. The writer must ensure each submission carries enough identity information (a deterministic operation ID) that duplicates can be recognized\u2014this is safety, not idempotency, because the writer does not guarantee that two appends produce one entry. On the read/replay path, the deduplication filter ensures that processing the same key twice has the same effect as processing it once\u2014this is idempotency, applied to the consumer's state transition function. The append-only log's contract is: writers provide safety (identifiable retries), the log provides the raw history, and the replay engine provides idempotency (deduplication).","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
